publication_mode: One public update commit over the previous public release; development history is retained separately.
publication_changes: README.md: link to the recorded-revision explanation and clarify Python requirements
docs/evidence/README.md: explain public history and source-hash verification
docs/compiled-programs.md: distinguish standalone and viewer Python requirements
docs/signal-console.md: include the dependency installation step and Python minimum
SOURCE_IDENTITY.json: record the export origin and publication scope
scripts/matvec_benchmark.py and its tests: support report output on a different Windows drive
docs/benchmarks/matvec/run.json: refresh the 90-case benchmark provenance after the report-link fix; measured CSV values are unchanged
scripts/runner-self-test.ps1: make Unicode and legacy-encoding fixtures independent of Windows locale
.github/workflows/lint.yml: use tested Verilator 5.048 instead of the distribution's older release
.github/workflows/extended-verification.yml: use the action-reported MSYS2 location and keep native Python first on PATH
scripts/synth-smoke.ps1: build native script paths on Windows/Linux and print failed-tool diagnostics
.github/workflows/lint.yml and synth-smoke.yml: retain tool logs and summaries as CI artifacts
release/current: refresh the portable verification snapshot after the CI portability fixes
evidence_policy: Recorded source_commit values are original development identities and are not rewritten to the public commit. They may not be reachable in public Git history. Package source manifests and artifact hashes identify the measured inputs and preserved outputs.
scope_note: Publication preparation does not claim a new FPGA implementation or physical-board run. Fresh software checks are distinct from the preserved dated hardware measurements.
